enter_sequence.text: Webb Industries data center. Server hum, blue glow, and your faces looping on every monitor.

enter_sequence.speaker: WEBB
enter_sequence.text: Cute infiltration. You're still running my firmware.

defeat_sequence.speaker: WEBB
defeat_sequence.text: I sold your faces, your routes, your heartbeats. The Sorrows were just another product launch.

defeat_sequence.speaker: WEBB
defeat_sequence.text: You think revenge is justice? I think it's a bad quarterly.

defeat_sequence.speaker: WEBB
defeat_sequence.text: Spare the genius and I wipe the warrants. Flatten me and every feed in the city loops your kill cam.

choice_sequence.prompt: Webb's mech suit sparks out. What now?

spare_sequence.text: Webb purges the warrants and jack out through a maintenance hatch.

execute_sequence.text: The feeds go dark. The Trader's data empire crumbles with him.
